title: triggers.yaml: the intake sources besides the CLI

model.description: model of the queued task; one of the project's worker kind models

webhooks.description: signed webhooks by name, served at POST /api/v1/webhooks/<name>

kind.description: forge: a labelled issue queues a task; alert: a firing alert queues an analysis; release: a published release deploys its image

project.description: project the task goes to; for release the project whose release is deployed

secret_env.description: environment variable that holds the HMAC-SHA256 secret of the signature

label.description: forge: the issue label that queues the task

cron.description: tasks queued on a fixed interval, by name

every.description: interval between two runs; the first is due one interval after it is first armed

release.description: where a release webhook queues the image bump (SCENARIOS DR-1)

project.description: the config repo project whose compose module is bumped; its base is read

compose_glob.description: git pathspec of the compose modules in the config repo
